Authentication.requirement: Verify login, registration, password recovery, token refresh, and logout functionalities

test_cases.desc: Login with valid credentials
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Login page.
2. Enter a valid registered email.
3. Enter the correct password.
4. Click 'Login'.
test_cases.expected: User is logged in successfully and redirected to Dashboard.
test_cases.pre: User already has a valid account

test_cases.desc: Login with invalid password
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Login page.
2. Enter a valid registered email.
3. Enter an incorrect password.
4. Click 'Login'.
test_cases.expected: Error message is shown: 'Invalid email or password'.
test_cases.pre: User already has a valid account

test_cases.desc: Login with missing fields
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Login page.
2. Leave email and password blank.
3. Click 'Login'.
test_cases.expected: Error message is shown for required fields: 'Email and password are required'.

test_cases.desc: Login with locked / inactive account
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter credentials of an account where isActive = false.
2. Click 'Login'.
test_cases.expected: Error message is shown: 'Your account has been locked or is not activated'.

test_cases.desc: Register with valid information
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Register page.
2. Enter valid Name, Email, Phone, Password.
3. Select role (Owner or Tenant).
4. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expected: Account is created successfully and welcome email is sent via SMTP.
test_cases.pre: User does not have an account in the system

test_cases.desc: Register with existing email
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Register page.
2. Enter an email that is already registered.
3. Fill other fields.
4. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expected: Error message is shown: 'Email already registered'.
test_cases.pre: User already has a valid account with the email

test_cases.desc: Register with invalid password format (under 6 chars)
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Register page.
2. Enter password '123' (too short).
3. Fill other fields.
4. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expected: Error message is shown regarding password length/format: 'Password must be at least 6 characters'.

test_cases.desc: Register with mismatched confirm password
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter Password 'Pass123@' and Confirm Password 'Pass456@'.
2. Click 'Register'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Confirm password does not match'.

test_cases.desc: Sign in with Google OAuth successfully
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Authorize Google account on popup.
3. Exchange auth code.
test_cases.expected: System logs user in, creates or links account, issues JWT access token and session cookie.

test_cases.desc: Google OAuth consent cancelled by user
test_cases.proc:
1. Click 'Đăng nhập bằng Google'.
2. Close the Google popup window without consenting.
test_cases.expected: Popup closes safely; user remains on login page with no crash or error.

test_cases.desc: Request reset link with valid email
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Forgot Password page.
2. Enter registered email.
3. Click 'Submit'.
test_cases.expected: Success message is shown and password reset email is dispatched via SMTP.
test_cases.pre: User already has an account and a valid email

test_cases.desc: Request reset link with unregistered email
test_cases.proc:
1. Go to Forgot Password page.
2. Enter an email not in the system.
3. Click 'Submit'.
test_cases.expected: System shows a generic message for security: 'If the email exists, a reset link was sent'.

test_cases.desc: Reset password with valid token and new password
test_cases.proc:
1. Open reset link with valid token.
2. Enter new password and confirm password.
3. Click 'Submit'.
test_cases.expected: Password updated successfully; old password invalidated; user can log in with new password.

test_cases.desc: Reset password with expired or tampered token
test_cases.proc:
1. Open reset link with an expired token (> 48h).
2. Enter new password and submit.
test_cases.expected: Error message: 'Password reset link has expired or is invalid. Please request a new one'.

test_cases.desc: View and update profile information successfully
test_cases.proc:
1. Navigate to Profile page.
2. Update Full Name and valid phone number.
3. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: Profile information updated in DB; success message displayed; header updates user name.

test_cases.desc: Update profile with invalid phone number format
test_cases.proc:
1. Enter phone number '123' or 'abcd'.
2. Click 'Save changes'.
test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Invalid phone number format'. Update blocked.

Contract Management.requirement: Verify direct rental contract lifecycle: Owner draft creation, paper agreement upload, Tenant review/confirmation/changes/rejection, draft deletion, and renewals

test_cases.proc:

test_cases.desc: Tenant confirms submitted contract

test_cases.desc: Unauthorized user attempts to confirm contract

test_cases.desc: Tenant requests changes without entering explanation note

1. Leave feedback note empty.
2. Click Submit.

test_cases.desc: Tenant rejects contract proposal with mandatory reason

test_cases.desc: Delete SKU that has active stock batches
test_cases.proc: 1. Click delete on SKU having recorded inventory.
test_cases.expected: Error: 'Không thể xóa SKU đang có tồn kho' (SKU_IN_USE).

test_cases.desc: Retrieve all stock batches stored across warehouse bins
test_cases.proc:

2. Select leased warehouse.
3. View batches table.

test_cases.desc: Create inbound receipt with valid items and destination bins
test_cases.proc:

test_cases.desc: Create inbound receipt exceeding bin capacity
test_cases.proc:

test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Trọng lượng hoặc thể tích hàng nhập vượt quá sức chứa tối đa của bin'.

test_cases.desc: Approve inbound receipt and record stock into warehouse bins
test_cases.proc:
1. Open pending inbound receipt.
2. Confirm physical count.
3. Click 'Duyệt nhập kho'.
test_cases.expected: Receipt status updates to APPROVED; stock batches added to DB with status AVAILABLE.

test_cases.desc: Create outbound receipt with FIFO batch allocation
test_cases.proc:

test_cases.desc: Create outbound receipt exceeding available warehouse stock
test_cases.proc:
1. Available stock is 20 units.

test_cases.expected: Error message: 'Số lượng yêu cầu vượt quá tồn kho khả dụng' (INSUFFICIENT_STOCK).

test_cases.desc: Approve outbound receipt, deduct stock batches, and dispatch goods
test_cases.proc:

2. Confirm picking list.
3. Click 'Xác nhận xuất kho'.
test_cases.expected: Receipt status updates to APPROVED; batch quantity deducted; reserved quantity cleared.

test_cases.desc: Tenant schedules inventory audit and assigns counter staff
test_cases.proc:

test_cases.expected: Audit ticket created in DRAFT status; counter staff assigned.

test_cases.desc: Create audit when an audit is already in progress on same warehouse
test_cases.proc: 1. Attempt to create second audit while first audit is IN_PROGRESS.
test_cases.expected: Error: 'Kho hàng đang có đợt kiểm kê đang diễn ra'.

test_cases.desc: Manager approves audit results and reconciles stock variances
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Tenant manager (different from counter).
2. Review discrepancy report.
3. Click 'Duyệt điều chỉnh tồn kho'.
test_cases.expected: Audit status updates to APPROVED; stock variance adjustments applied; warehouse movement lock released.
test_cases.pre: Audit is Submitted with discrepancy count, approver != counter

test_cases.desc: Assigned counter attempts to approve their own submitted audit
test_cases.proc: 1. Same staff who counted submits approval.
test_cases.expected: System rejects with 403 Forbidden: 'Người trực tiếp kiểm đếm không được phép tự duyệt kiểm kê'.

test_cases.desc: Tenant cancels an in-progress inventory audit ticket with reason
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as Tenant manager.
2. Open active audit ticket in IN_PROGRESS state.
3. Click 'Hủy phiếu kiểm kê'.
4. Enter cancellation reason: 'Kế hoạch kiểm kê tạm hoãn do kho tiếp nhận lô hàng đột xuất'.
5. Confirm cancellation.
test_cases.expected: Audit status updates to CANCELLED; review reason and timestamp recorded; warehouse stock freeze lock immediately released.
test_cases.pre: Audit ticket is in IN_PROGRESS status, user is Tenant manager

test_cases.desc: Attempt to cancel an already APPROVED audit ticket
test_cases.proc:
1. Open an audit ticket with status APPROVED.
2. Trigger cancel audit action.
test_cases.expected: System returns HTTP 400 Bad Request: 'Phiếu kiểm kê đã được duyệt hoặc đã bị hủy trước đó, không thể hủy tiếp' (AUDIT_ALREADY_PROCESSED).

test_cases.desc: Assigned counter staff attempts to cancel audit ticket without manager authority
test_cases.proc:
1. Log in as assigned counter staff (not manager).
2. Send request to cancel audit ticket.
test_cases.expected: System rejects with HTTP 403 Forbidden: 'Chỉ người quản lý của tổ chức thuê mới có quyền hủy phiếu kiểm kê'.
test_cases.pre: Caller is counter staff, not tenant reviewer

test_cases.desc: Create and approve internal bin-to-bin stock transfer

test_cases.desc: Transfer to identical source bin
test_cases.proc:

test_cases.expected: Validation error: 'Vị trí bin đích phải khác với vị trí bin nguồn'.
